claims.text: Thompson Madrid is set beside Plaza del Carmen, moments from Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, Gran Via and Plaza de Espana.

findings.quote: Set beside Plaza del Carmen, just moments from Puerta del Sol, Plaza Mayor, Gran Vía and Plaza de España

claims.text: The nearest metro stations are Gran Via and Sol.

findings.quote: Simply hop on the metro at nearby Gran Vía or Sol station.

claims.text: Rooms and suites bring together natural wood, leather and marble with residential-inspired contemporary design.

findings.quote: Inspired by residential living, our guestrooms and suites are rooted in local character, bringing together natural wood, leather and marble with contemporary design.

claims.text: Rooms come with D.S. & Durga bath amenities and a rain shower.

findings.quote: Each includes inviting and locally inspired décor, referencing waterfalls, sculptural silhouettes, and earth tones, with high-end extras: luxury linens, D.S. & Durga bath amenities, a rain shower and more.

claims.text: Rooms have a minifridge stocked with locally sourced products.

findings.quote: Minifridge with locally sourced products

claims.text: Select rooms and suites have private terraces.

findings.quote: Large windows and private terraces in select accommodations offer panoramic views across the city

claims.text: The Penthouse occupies the top floor and has a private balcony overlooking landmarks including Puerta del Sol and the Royal Palace.

findings.quote: Occupying the top floor of Thompson Madrid, the Penthouse offers a residential retreat with panoramic views across the city’s skyline.
a private balcony overlooking landmarks including Puerta del Sol and the Royal Palace

claims.text: La Barra de Ultramarines is a traditional Spanish bar in the hotel where tapas are made for sharing.

findings.quote: Experience the lively atmosphere of a traditional Spanish bar at Barra de Ultramarines, where tapas are made for sharing
This welcoming restaurant brings the spirit of Madrid’s neighborhood bars to Thompson Madrid

claims.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours a day.

findings.quote: Enjoy the convenience of 24-hour in-room dining at Thompson Madrid

claims.text: The hotel has a 24-hour fitness center.

findings.quote: 24-hour fitness center

claims.text: The hotel welcomes both dogs and cats.

findings.quote: Thompson Madrid, by Hyatt, is a pet-friendly hotel that welcomes both dogs and cats.

claims.text: The hotel's carpeting pays homage to Madrid's cobblestoned streets.

findings.quote: The hotel’s carpeting pays an homage to Madrid’s cobblestoned streets

claims.text: Jack's Club is an intimate piano bar inspired by classic speakeasies and the charm of a private library, with live jazz and signature cocktails.

findings.quote: Step into Jack’s Club, an intimate piano bar inspired by classic speakeasies and the timeless charm of a private library. Rich décor, live jazz and expertly crafted signature cocktails

claims.text: The building, designed by the firm Lopez y Tena, is defined by two large central courtyards that let light in.

findings.quote:
The most notable feature of the building, designed by the firm
López y Tena
, is its two large central courtyards which allow light to enter

claims.text: Thompson Terrace Suite and Penthouse guests can borrow handcrafted capes by Spanish fashion house OTEYZA.

findings.quote: As a Terrace Suite guest, you will also have exclusive access to handcrafted capes by Spanish fashion house OTEYZA, available to borrow
As a Penthouse guest, you will also enjoy exclusive access to handcrafted capes by Spanish fashion house OTEYZA, available to borrow throughout your stay.

claims.text: Makaa is the rooftop restaurant, bringing together Mediterranean cuisine, open-fire cooking and panoramic city views.

findings.quote: Discover Makáá, Thompson Madrid’s rooftop restaurant, where Mediterranean cuisine, open-fire cooking and panoramic city views come together.

claims.text: Works by local artists hang throughout the hotel, with a different floor dedicated to each artist.

findings.quote: works by local artists including Andrea Torres, Marta Bermejo, Pils Ferrer, Mercedes Garrido, and Miguel Vallinas hang from the walls—each has a different floor dedicated to them
